# History rewrite note (2026-10-04)

The commit history was rewritten twice on 2026-10-04, in the same day, to correct commit metadata and a few text references.

**What changed:** commit author and trailer metadata, the text of commit messages, and two documentation files
(`README.md` and `docs/HANDOFF_FOR_PPT.md`), where a branch name and a file name were replaced in text.

**What did not change:** every other file, byte for byte. This includes all protocol files, data, results and code.
For 49 of the 79 commits the tree hash is identical before and after; for the other 30 only those two documentation
files differ. The parent structure, including the merged pull requests, is identical.

The development branch was renamed to `dev`.

Because every commit hash changed, the hashes written into the sealed-run lock files (`data/*/.*_used`, field
`protocol_commit`) refer to the commits as they were **before** the rewrite. The lock files were not edited,
so they stay exactly as written when the sealed runs were made. Use the table to find the same commit today.

| Lock file | protocol_commit when the run was made | Same commit now |
|---|---|---|
| `data/fresh/.fresh_used` | `aec7b6f288705ee5d492a63be3c900c8d44a5290` | `a8771f66a29fea349070ca9ed0638a08963489aa` |
| `data/fresh2/.fresh2_used` | `1a501f1939b7d7859fa62ec8fd081c84223ca36b` | `409f147dee22fa0415f9618a6f6e6a3934f40354` |
| `data/fresh3/.fresh3_used` | `cbacfe6c25732673ec535679d6749e1f6b7fd4c4` | `65d81489ea8fe22d4ced4b812db23c0a9ca364d3` |
| `data/fresh4/.fresh4_used` | `7fcbf327b61b047e6ae7ddbe872a676fc721d8de` | `b47ea44d9d97e715a74dd74f085821aad843a88d` |
| `data/holdout/.holdout_used` | `9cd24f14db5bad248bedf24f3428e6f2031c8a41` | `3d9a2c35dfe07da6d5c9157f831cc43bc9e14755` |
